chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him), he draws attention to the encompassing knowledge of Allah regarding particulars, then urges towards piety and clarifies the virtue of Islam and the Quran.

key_terms.الجزئيات: Particulars or specific details (as opposed to generalities)

ai.seo_question: What are the main themes of Imam Ali's sermon regarding divine knowledge and piety?
ai.summary: This introductory note to a sermon of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) outlines the sermon's structure: it begins by highlighting Allah's comprehensive knowledge of all details (al-jaza'iyat), moves to an exhortation for God-consciousness (taqwa), and concludes by emphasizing the superiority of Islam and the Quran. In Shia exegesis, this progression underscores that true taqwa arises from the awareness of divine omniscience, while the elevation of the Quran serves as the practical manifestation of Islam's spiritual authority.
